title: Simplicity in Christ
author: Michael Cziesla
notes_text: 1.  Green Jell-O with carrots is a local Utah dish, where shredded carrots are added to the cooling Jell-O; for funeral potatoes, cornflakes are spread on top of a potato dish (see Rachel E. Teixeira, “Utah Food Lore,” Y Magazine [Summer 2022], magazine.byu.edu).

2.  Reference to the famous last sentence from Music & the Spoken Word , first introduced by Richard L. Evans: “Again we leave you from within the shadows of the everlasting hills. May peace be with you this day and always.”

Nelson’s message to every member of the Church during his first address as President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (see “ As We Go Forward Together ,” Ensign or Liahona, Apr. 2018, 7). See also Russell M. Nelson, “ Come, Follow Me ,” Ensign or Liahona , May 2019, 88–91.
